baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at words 3-5, where the word becomes binding upon them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The obligation branch of the first root acts on the utterance branch of the second: speech is not merely descriptive but a sentence whose claim has become due and rests on its subjects.

activation_trace.role: Supplies fixed obligation and desert, making the word a liability that has come due rather than a passing statement.
Supplies articulated speech, which functions here as the content on which binding force operates.

changed_reading.before: A statement is simply said about the condemned.
changed_reading.after: An articulated judgment has matured into an enforceable claim resting on them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 7-11: among communities that passed before them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Community, shared way, elapsed generation, and precedence combine into a chain of repeatable collective trajectories. The subjects are located inside that chain, not merely compared with remote people.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a collectivity held together by a common feature and makes the enclosing preposition mark membership.
Adds a shared way or practice, allowing the communities to be recurrent alignments rather than ethnic containers alone.
Supplies the passing away of an age or generation and carries the collective pattern through time.
Supplies temporal precedence, arranging earlier communities as a line into which the present case enters.

changed_reading.before: They resemble some peoples who lived earlier.
changed_reading.after: They have entered a recurring community-path already traversed by earlier generations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired classes at words 13-14, the jinn and humankind.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hidden class and the perceptible human class form a concealed-to-manifest span of accountable society. The pair widens the jurisdiction of the loss claim rather than supplying two unrelated examples.

activation_trace.role: Supplies hidden beings and occupies the concealed pole of the paired classification.
Supplies visible human presence in contrast to hiddenness and completes the manifest pole.
Turns both ontological classes into possible communities organized by a shared condition.
Supplies deficit as the common outcome that can span both hidden and visible agents.

changed_reading.before: Two species are listed among the condemned.
changed_reading.after: The verse spans concealed and manifest accountable society, locating losing communities in both domains.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The relation between the exactness of word 3 and the loss named at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth as exact correspondence meets commercial loss and deficient measure. The ending can therefore describe an audited negative balance, not only an undifferentiated state of ruin.

activation_trace.role: Supplies exact correspondence with reality and functions as the standard against which the deficit is exposed.
Supplies commercial loss and casts the final state as a failed exchange or negative account.
Adds short measure, making the failure one of measurable insufficiency rather than mood alone.

changed_reading.before: They are generically ruined.
changed_reading.after: An exact adjudication discloses them as measurably short and commercially in deficit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possible relation of the word at word 5 to the way shared by the communities at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech can carry a professed belief, while a community can be constituted by a followed way. On this reading the binding word is not only an external decree; it also exposes the stance by which the subjects align themselves with a losing collective.

activation_trace.role: Supplies speech as belief or position and permits the word to carry an adopted stance.
Supplies a collective way and turns the stance into a mode of affiliation.
Supplies the binding consequence that attaches to the professed alignment.

changed_reading.before: The word is exclusively an external sentence imposed on passive subjects.
changed_reading.after: The sentence may also crystallize a professed stance by which its subjects join a recurrent losing way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The descended book, creation in truth, and an appointed terminus recast the binding word as a decree entered into an ordered reality and maturing at a fixed horizon.

activation_trace.role: Keeps the focus construction anchored in obligation that has become due.
Keeps the decree recognizably attached to the focus word rather than to context imagery alone.
Supplies inscription that establishes an obligatory ruling or determination, giving the focus word a registered form.
Places exact truth in the created order and supplies the reality within which the decree operates.
Supplies a fixed endpoint, turning binding force into something that reaches maturity on schedule.

structural_cues: 46:2-3 moves from a descended book to creation in truth with a fixed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, truth, and a fixed term; I infer that the binding word operates like a registered decree maturing on schedule. A live alternative is an oral promise merely associated with those motifs.

changed_reading.before: The binding word is an isolated judicial utterance.
changed_reading.after: It is a registered determination embedded in an ordered creation and arriving at its appointed horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand for a prior book or a surviving trace turns precedence into an evidence relation. Earlier communities become an inspectable case archive whose remains support the present verdict.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the focus verse's temporal precedence.
Supplies elapsed generations as the archive's historical cases.
Supplies a written record as one demanded form of evidence.
Repeats precedence inside the evidence challenge and links the earlier record to the focus's earlier communities.
Supplies a surviving mark that discloses what once existed, making vanished peoples evidentiary remains.

structural_cues: 46:4 frames prior authority as a challenge to produce either a book or a residue of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demand for prior documentary or residual proof; I infer that the past communities function as precedent cases. They could instead remain chronology with no legal evidentiary role.

changed_reading.before: Past nations are remote analogues.
changed_reading.after: Their precedence is an evidence trail: prior cases and surviving marks make the present classification inspectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages rival acts of speech: evident truth is called magic, revelation is alleged to be fabricated, a witness speaks from knowledge, and the resistant child reduces resurrection to inherited tales. The focus word can therefore close a speech contest in which human sayings disclose the stance answered by the binding counter-word.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed model in the focus's articulated word.
Gives the counter-word binding force after the contest of claims.
Supplies the spoken relabeling of manifest signs as magic and opens the contest over what speech names as true.
Supplies the accusation of invented falsehood and makes fabrication one rival account of the revelation.
Supplies testimony grounded in knowledge and gives the speech contest an evidentiary axis.
Supplies speech as a held position; the child's two utterances expose the doctrinal alignment immediately answered by 46:18.

structural_cues: The recurring say-call-witness sequence culminates immediately before the focus in the child's dismissal of resurrection as old tales.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed claims, testimony, and the adjacent resistant utterance; I infer that those sayings help constitute the case to which the binding word answers. The alternative remains that the focus word is solely a prior divine decree with no self-implicating speech mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A divine statement descends without relation to the subjects' own language.
changed_reading.after: The binding counter-word resolves a long contest of naming and answers a stance that the subjects have spoken into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior book, an exemplar, and a confirming book convert community from a demographic mass into a formation organized around guidance, transmitted text, and a followed way.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the communities named by the focus.
Allows collective identity to be constituted by a shared way rather than descent alone.
Supplies an earlier textual stage in the chain of orientation.
Supplies the two written texts that bracket the exemplar and organize transmission.
Supplies an exemplar or guide followed by others and activates an orienting center inside the focus's community root.
Supplies fulfillment through confirming action, binding the later text to the earlier one rather than replacing it.

structural_cues: 46:12 places an earlier book, an exemplar, and a confirming Arabic book in one transmission sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared community-exemplar root and a confirming textual chain; I infer that the focus communities are formed by orientation around a way. A demographic sense remains fully live alongside it.

changed_reading.before: The communities are merely populations from different times.
changed_reading.after: They are also formations gathered around transmitted orientations, exemplars, and repeated ways.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired family portraits contrast gratitude that repairs across parents and offspring with speech that rejects the parents by invoking elapsed generations. The focus then classifies the speaker inside prior communities, suggesting adoption of a recurrent stance rather than inherited guilt by blood.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the classification in speech as a professed position.
Makes entry into the earlier communities entry into their recurrent way.
Supplies biological parenthood on both sides of the grateful speaker and establishes the descent relation that the moral contrast will not simply equate with fate.
Supplies the grateful adult's spoken orientation as one possible inherited-and-renewed stance.
Supplies the rejecting child's contrary position, which aligns him with the discourse of earlier deniers.
Supplies generations already gone as the premise the child turns into an objection.
Supplies cohorts joined in one time and makes the child's appeal to old generations a collective genealogy of stance.

structural_cues: 46:15-17 juxtaposes gratitude across parents and offspring with a child who uses prior generations to resist his parents' warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies biological kinship and opposed speech across the two portraits; I infer self-enrollment in a moral-discursive lineage, not transfer of guilt through ancestry. The live alternative is that the earlier communities are only a historical comparison.

changed_reading.before: Membership among former nations sounds like inherited collective fate.
changed_reading.after: The adjacent child joins their way by repeating their stance, while the contrasting child shows that biological lineage does not determine the classification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acceptance of good work and the true promise in 46:16 stand beside the warning that God's promise is true in 46:17 and the adverse word becoming due in 46:18. Binding truth therefore supports two responsive outcomes, not an arbitrary one-sided doom.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the adverse side in an obligation or desert that has become fixed.
Anchors that fixed outcome in the focus's word.
Supplies favorable acceptance and establishes the positive responsive track beside the focus's adverse one.
Supplies promise as speech that opens expectation, pairing beneficent promised speech with the focus word.
Supplies fulfillment of promise in action and makes the positive outcome performatively true.
Carries promise into the warning immediately before the focus and keeps the two outcomes in one speech structure.
Declares the promise exactly true just before the focus shifts from truth to binding desert.

structural_cues: 46:16-18 forms a tight sequence of accepted deeds, true promise, rejected warning, and binding word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent positive and adverse promise language; I infer a matched responsive structure in which the same reliability grounds both outcomes. The adverse word could still denote an independent decree rather than the negative side of that pairing.

changed_reading.before: The word appears as an isolated sentence of loss.
changed_reading.after: It is the adverse side of a reliable promise structure that also accepts and rewards a contrary response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Degrees, full settlement of works, and pleasures already spent convert loss into a graduated account. The deficit is exact and individualized: enjoyed assets have gone while works are paid without shortage.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the exact standard under which the account is settled.
Supplies commercial loss as the focus outcome to be unpacked by the later accounting sequence.
Supplies deficient measure and makes the loss quantifiable.
Supplies stepwise gradation and prevents the loss classification from flattening all cases.
Supplies complete payment without deficiency, making the final deficit the result of full settlement rather than underpayment.
Supplies goods as already gone or spent and removes them from the remaining balance.
Supplies enjoyed benefit as the consumed value whose exhaustion sharpens the loss.

structural_cues: 46:19 individualizes degrees and full recompense; 46:20 answers with good things already expended in worldly life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gradation, full payment, and consumed benefits; I infer a ledger in which the focus loss is the resulting negative balance. A live alternative is that loss remains a general eschatological label and the accounting language is only adjacent explanation.

changed_reading.before: Loss is a single undifferentiated fate.
changed_reading.after: Loss is the exact deficit left after graded works are settled in full and previously enjoyed value has been exhausted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Aad sequence leaves only dwellings, then points to destroyed settlements around the audience. Passing away acquires a spatial residue: communities have vacated inhabited places, and their absence remains locally visible.

activation_trace.role: Supplies emptiness of place and lets the focus verb carry spatial vacancy alongside temporal passage.
Retains the ordinary passing of generations while the context adds visible absence.
Reintroduces earlier warnings as a passed sequence and begins the concrete historical case.
Supplies comprehensive destruction as the mechanism producing the vacancy.
Supplies inhabited dwellings, which remain visible after their inhabitants have passed.
Supplies collapse into extinction for nearby settlements and generalizes the Aad case.
Places the ruined evidence around the present audience rather than at an abstract historical distance.
Supplies settlements as gathered human habitation, the material containers now emptied of their communities.

structural_cues: 46:25 narrows visibility to dwellings alone, and 46:27 relocates destroyed settlements around the hearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destroyed people, remaining dwellings, and nearby settlements; I infer that the focus verb carries spatial evacuation as well as elapsed time. The alternative is ordinary historical succession with ruins serving only as a later illustration.

changed_reading.before: Earlier communities have simply receded into past time.
changed_reading.after: They have vacated inhabited space, leaving nearby dwellings as the visible negative shape of their passing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of mocked consequence descending and enclosing its subjects gives material force to the focus's word resting upon them. A legal sentence becomes an outcome that closes around its bearers.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the binding force of the focus construction.
Keeps the enclosing force attached to the focus word as judgment.
Supplies harmful consequence descending and surrounding its subjects, functioning as the concrete realization of binding judgment.

structural_cues: The focus attaches the word upon its subjects, while 46:26 attaches the mocked consequence around them with a near-sounding but distinct root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel attachment frames and two distinct near-sounding roots; I infer a narrative echo from binding to enclosure, not an etymological identity. The live alternative is that the resemblance is accidental and the focus remains purely juridical.

changed_reading.before: The word is legally binding but abstract.
changed_reading.after: Its binding is pictured as the denied outcome descending and closing around the people who mocked it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jinn later hear with understanding, fall silent attentively, and carry warning back, while response to the caller separates forgiveness from inescapability. The focus's jinn-human pair therefore marks the reach of accountability; it does not make either species essentially losing.

activation_trace.role: Anchors one accountable class in hidden beings named by the focus.
Anchors the corresponding visible human class and preserves the cross-species span.
Makes loss a property of communities within each class rather than a property of the classes themselves.
Reactivates the same hidden beings as receptive agents and directly prevents an essentializing reading.
Supplies hearing as understanding and compliance, the response that moves these jinn away from the losing pattern.
Supplies attentive silence as the social discipline enabling reception.
Supplies an answering response and makes classification turn on what agents do with the call.
Supplies the spoken call toward which response or refusal is directed.
Supplies inability to outrun or escape, defining the consequence of nonresponse rather than an inherited species fate.

structural_cues: 46:29 repeats the jinn class from the focus but narrates attentive reception, return to their people, and warning; 46:31-32 then bifurcates answer from refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receptive jinn and a response-based bifurcation; I infer that the focus names losing communities drawn from both species, not both species as doomed wholes. A narrower alternative is that 46:29 is unrelated counterexample material and 46:18 refers only to some past members.

changed_reading.before: The jinn-human pair can sound like a blanket condemnation of both classes.
changed_reading.after: It defines a cross-species jurisdiction in which responsive jinn demonstrate that loss attaches to communal response, not ontology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final question, compelled acknowledgment, and command to experience punishment enact the earlier binding word. Truth moves from disputed proposition to admitted reality and then to embodied consequence.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the later enactment in the focus's binding desert.
Anchors the enactment in the focus word as articulated judgment.
Supplies truth as exact reality in the question that demands recognition.
Supplies both answer and judicial reply, turning the word into a performed dialogue.
Supplies experiential testing and converts acknowledged truth into lived consequence.

structural_cues: 46:34 is a question-answer-command sequence: recognition of truth is immediately followed by experiential consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a final dialogue that joins truth, speech, and experience; I infer that it stages the realization of the focus word. The alternative is that the dialogue is a later confirmation with no special backward link to 46:18.

changed_reading.before: The word becomes binding offstage as a prior decree.
changed_reading.after: The surah later performs that word as recognition, reply, and embodied consequence in one dialogic event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the focus spelling, so it is form-distant from ordinary speech morphology. It remains anchored to word 5 and converges with the explicit loss root at word 17; downstream prose should present diminution and instability only as a secondary acoustic-morphological activation, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of word 5 alongside the final loss predicate.

activation_trace.role: Supplies smallness and diminution, allowing the binding word to sound as a designation that reduces standing.
Supplies disturbance and lack of stability, adding a destabilized condition to the act of being diminished.
Provides the explicit deficit that keeps the unusual split-root activation attached to the focus outcome.

changed_reading.before: The word only declares a preexisting loss.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory secondary resonance, the binding designation also diminishes and unsettles the standing of those it names.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Linking jinn and garden through their shared root is surprising because the surface nouns belong to distinct conventional senses. The shared covering image remains securely root-anchored, and the later receptive jinn make the moral-neutrality claim useful; downstream prose should use it as a contrast in kinds of concealment, not claim that garden and jinn are interchangeable meanings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hidden beings at word 13, read against the same root's sheltered-garden use and its later return to receptive jinn.

activation_trace.role: Supplies hidden beings and anchors concealment in the focus classification.
Supplies a garden covered by growth and turns concealment into shelter and flourishing on the contrasting positive path.
Returns hidden beings as listeners, confirming that hiddenness itself does not determine loss.

changed_reading.before: Concealment in the jinn label carries an implicitly negative moral coloring.
changed_reading.after: The root's sheltered garden and its receptive hidden listeners separate concealment from condemnation: covering can house flourishing or accountable agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus grammar strongly favors temporal precedence, so converting it into physical confrontation would be excessive. The facing branch is nonetheless anchored in the same root and becomes vivid when the awaited cloud faces the valleys; downstream prose should retain this only as a spatial overlay in which past peoples stand before the audience as an approaching warning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word for before at word 11, activated by the same root's frontal use in 46:24.

activation_trace.role: Supplies face-to-face orientation as an exploratory spatial layer on the focus's temporal predecessor relation.
Materializes the branch in the cloud facing the valleys and lets prior warning feel as though it advances toward the present audience.

changed_reading.before: Earlier nations lie behind the audience on a timeline.
changed_reading.after: As an imagistic overlay, those predecessors also stand before the audience like the approaching sign they failed to read.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The time-span branch of the focus community root is unusual because the plural here most readily denotes peoples. It remains packet-licensed and is activated by the closing compression of apparent duration into part of a day; downstream prose should keep temporal community as a co-resonance, not erase the ordinary collective sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The communities at word 7 and their passing at word 9, heard against the closing contraction of duration.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an interval or span of time and allows each community to carry an epochal dimension.
Supplies elapsed time and links the epochal community to passage.
Supplies duration as remaining in a place, which the closing comparison radically contracts.
Supplies daylight as an opened temporal field within which the apparently long stay is compressed.

changed_reading.before: The verse points only to groups located far back in history.
changed_reading.after: Each community also carries an epoch, and the closing time compression makes those apparently remote epochs nearly adjacent at fulfillment.

strongest_changes: The immediate parent-child contrast turns membership among prior communities into self-enrollment through repeated stance, not inherited guilt.
The listening jinn episode makes the jinn-human pair a cross-species field of accountable response rather than a blanket ontology of loss.
Full settlement and spent benefits make loss an exact, graded deficit, while ruined dwellings make the passage of former communities materially present.
The final question-answer-experience sequence performs the binding word instead of leaving it as an abstract prior decree.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly changed when its roots reappeared in opposed roles: community beside exemplar, temporal before beside acceptance and facing, hidden beings beside a sheltered garden and receptive jinn, and true promise beside binding adverse word. These recurrences preserved several live models rather than forcing one referent for the word.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus word denotes only a divine decree or also gathers the subjects' self-implicating speech into the judgment.
How much weight the distinct-root sound echo between binding and enclosing consequence can bear beyond narrative imagery.
Whether the time-span community branch and the non-dominant diminution mapping should remain outliers or enter downstream prose.
